decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the stands hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing stands.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith and numbered  BT/1/HR, BT/2/HR, BT/3/HR, BT/4/HR, BT/5/HR and TB/1/BG and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The floodlights, hereby permitted, shall only be operated between the hours of 14.00 and 23.00 and during no more than three evenings in any one week.
description: Improvements to football ground incorporating relocation and provision of new spectator area; new emergency access and perimeter hardstanding, erection of additional pitch post, rail fencing; single turnstile and floodlighting to grass areas.
